# Cases whose comparison with the node oracle is not "ok" (see expect_test.go).

vl_1756	differ|ok	platform: the only text is U+1F415, an emoji. On Linux node-canvas (Pango 1.48) measures it with Noto Emoji's advance (25.39 px at 20px, as the engine does); on macOS (Pango 1.57) every emoji presentation sequence measures exactly one em (11 px at 11px), so the label is narrower and the autosized view one pixel narrower
